messages.text:
The toothbrush holder hasn’t been received back according to the shop’s records, so I can’t request a refund for it now. It must arrive first, and your message that you’ll mail it tomorrow isn’t enough to request a refund yet (refund-policy/v2/return). The order’s refund deadline has also passed, so a request after it arrives would be late too (refund-policy/v2/window).

The tumbler was already refunded for BRL 39.90, with receipt **R-H255-0001**. It can’t be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining). The receipt records the refund in the shop’s test ledger, not a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for when money may appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
